description: Department of Labour - Notify the Special allowance is respect of a normal working day in the Cocoa, Cardamom & Pepper growing and manufacturing trade (for the month of February, 2018 was 743.25)
categorisation: This gazette notification announces a special allowance payable to workers in the cocoa, cardamom, and pepper growing and manufacturing trade based on the Cost of Living Index. This falls under public sector services and administration as it deals with wage regulations and worker benefits, specifically under the authority of the Commissioner General of Labour. It does not involve government structure/personnel changes (Types 1-3) or fit any other specialized categories (4-7, 9), making it a Public Service Gazette (Type 8).
